svg.title: The AI expectations gap: US adults versus Anthropic staff
svg.desc: Paired horizontal bars from Anthropic's October 16, 2026 survey report. Expect a Nobel-level AI discovery by 2030: US adults 39 percent, Anthropic staff 91 percent. Expect AI to design, run and publish scientific studies by next year: US adults 38 percent, staff 90 percent. Expected share of AI-capable tasks actually using AI in 2030: US adults 42 percent, staff 65 percent. Expected share of own current work hours done by AI in 2030: US workers 28 percent, staff 75 percent. Footnote: median answers imply 2030 GDP growth of 5.4 percent for US adults and 17.1 percent for staff.
svg.text: The AI expectations gap (Anthropic survey, Oct 16)
Expect a Nobel-level AI discovery by 2030
Expect AI to design, run and publish studies by next year
Share of AI-capable tasks expected to use AI in 2030
Share of own work hours expected to be done by AI in 2030
Median answers imply 2030 US GDP growth of 5.4% (public) vs 17.1% (staff); scenario benchmarks 2.4% / 5.4% / 15.4%.
Last row: US workers only. Staff figures are personal views, not company forecasts. Source: anthropic.com/research/ai-expectations-gap
